description: This circular walk visits a series of pretty villages in the Lincolnshire Wolds. The walk follows a series of quiet roads and footpaths with some fine countryside views to enjoy along the way. The route also follows part of the ancient Roman salt road, which was used to carry salt from the coast to Lincoln.The route starts in Fulletby, first heading east to Salmonby where you can enjoy a stroll around the pretty Salmonby Lake. You continue north toTetfordbefore heading west through the fields to Belchford. The final section heads south along theViking Wayto return to Fulletby, the second highest village in the Lincolnshire Wolds.
